title: The Fall of Jerusalem (586 BC)
lead: The Babylonian siege of Jerusalem (January 588 to July 586 BC), the burning of Solomon's temple, and the deportation of the city's people. It is told in 2 Kings 25, Jeremiah 39 and 52, 2 Chronicles 36 and Lamentations, and remembered each year on the Ninth of Av. Some scholars date it to 587 BC.
